insights.text: CCO (uranium) is your most volatile holding. The sector needs supply tightness to hold—geopolitical support (Russia sanctions, nuclear commitments) is strong, but spot prices have stalled. Watch for a sustained move above $85/lb; if it breaks down, trim. Otherwise, the 3-5 year thesis (reactor restart/buildout) remains intact.

Your tech-heavy positions (XQQ, hardware) are exposed to US-China tariff escalation and a strong USD. AI demand is the engine—it's holding. But with Fed holding rates high into 2027, any earnings miss in AI names could amplify downside. Keep an eye on USD/CAD: parity hurts your CAD-based returns from US tech. No action now, but don't add here.
